claims.claim: In 2003 Barbra Streisand sued photographer Kenneth Adelman (and Pictopia.com) for US$50 million for violation of privacy over an aerial photograph of her Malibu home.
claims.episode_span: Barbra Streisand filed a $50 million lawsuit in Los Angeles Superior Court to force the removal of a single aerial photograph
claims.supporting_quote: In 2003, American singer and actress Barbra Streisand sued photographer Kenneth Adelman and Pictopia.com for US$50 million for violation of privacy

claims.claim: The disputed photo was one image in the publicly available California Coastal Records Project archive of 12,000 California coastline photographs documenting coastal erosion.
claims.episode_span: had been taken as one data point among 12,000 others in a public project mapping California’s eroding coastline
claims.supporting_quote: an aerial photograph in which Streisand's clifftop residence in Malibu was visible, from the publicly available California Coastal Records Project of 12,000 California coastline photographs

claims.claim: Before the lawsuit the image had been downloaded only six times, two of those by Streisand's own attorneys.
claims.episode_span: had been downloaded only six times before the legal papers arrived
claims.supporting_quote: had been downloaded only six times prior to Streisand's lawsuit, two of those being by Streisand's attorneys

claims.claim: The lawsuit was dismissed and Streisand was ordered to pay Adelman's legal fees (about $177,000).
claims.episode_span: Streisand ultimately lost the suit in 2003 and was ordered to reimburse Adelman’s legal costs
claims.supporting_quote: The lawsuit was dismissed and Streisand was ordered to pay Adelman's $177,000 legal attorney fees

claims.claim: Mike Masnick of Techdirt coined the term "Streisand Effect" in 2005, two years after the lawsuit, writing about a resort's takedown notice.
claims.episode_span: Tech journalist Mike Masnick later coined the term “Streisand Effect” in 2005
claims.supporting_quote: Two years later, Mike Masnick of Techdirt coined the term when writing about Marco Beach Ocean Resort's takedown notice to urinal.net
